issues.detail: Our WIN-010 claim is 'BOU 2017 eclipse -10.9 nT' (2017-08-21 eclipse, Boulder INTERMAGNET station, Kp≈3). The dome site's CURRENT WIN-010 entry (fetched from john09289.github.io/predictions/wins.html) is titled 'Eclipse Magnetic Signal Confirmed on Quiet Days' and is now entirely about the 2016-03-09 Pacific quiet-day eclipse (GUA/HON/MMB/CNB/GNG stations, Kp<2), explicitly contrasted against 2017 and 2024 as storm-contaminated non-evidence. The 2017 BOU -10.9nT / 6.5µGal datapoint has been repurposed by the dome author into a different entry, WIN-012 ('Magnetic-Gravity Coupling Constant', Source: 'BOU 2017 + Mohe 1997'). This is the author redefining what WIN-010 refers to without our review being updated to match.
